services.name: Clinical Psychopedagogical Assessment
services.description: An in-depth investigation using scientific protocols and clinical observation to identify the origin of learning difficulties and map the patient's cognitive profile.

services.name: Individual Psychopedagogical Intervention
services.description: Personalized sessions focused on rehabilitating learning functions, utilizing playful and clinical resources to overcome barriers diagnosed during the assessment.

services.name: Family Guidance and Mediation
services.description: Specialized consultancy to support and equip the family, aligning household dynamics with the learner's therapeutic needs.

services.name: School Inclusion Consultancy
services.description: Direct assistance for educational institutions in developing Individualized Education Programs (IEP) and curricular adaptations for students with specific needs.

services.name: Dyslexia and Literacy Rehabilitation
services.description: Intervention focused on phonological awareness and auditory processing, ideal for children in the literacy phase or those with a Dyslexia diagnosis.

services.name: Dyscalculia and Reasoning Intervention
services.description: Use of concrete materials and multisensory methods to develop numerical sense and logic, assisting those with severe difficulties regarding mathematical concepts.

services.name: Executive Function and ADHD Training
services.description: Development of organization strategies, impulse control, and working memory, focused on individuals with ADHD or brain-based planning difficulties.

services.name: Hospital Psychopedagogy
services.description: Pedagogical-therapeutic care for hospitalized patients, aimed at maintaining the connection with learning and providing emotional support during treatment.

services.name: Cognitive Stimulation for Seniors
services.description: A program for the prevention and maintenance of memory and language in the elderly, aiming for active aging and the preservation of cognitive autonomy.

services.name: Social Skills Workshop
services.description: Group training to develop emotional intelligence, interpretation of social cues, and empathetic interpersonal conflict resolution.

services.name: Graphomotor Re-education and Handwriting
services.description: Work focused on fine motor skills, pencil grip, and legibility, assisting those showing signs of Dysgraphia or excessive slowness in writing.

services.name: Vocational and Career Guidance
services.description: A process of self-knowledge and skill analysis to assist adolescents and adults in professional choices through profile and interest testing.

services.name: School Transition Preparation
services.description: Strategic support for students changing education cycles (e.g., Elementary to Middle School), helping them adapt to new routines and multiple teachers.

services.name: Anxiety Management and Test Strategies
services.description: Emotional regulation techniques and specific study methods to face evaluations and entrance exams with greater security, focus, and stress control.

services.name: Adult and University Psychopedagogy
services.description: Support for adults with academic or professional difficulties, focusing on critical reading, academic writing, and productive routine management in higher education.
